system.description:
Martial Affinity: You have a deep understanding of all things related to martials arts. You gain a +1 racial bonus to AB and DB when in any combat stance (GM discretion).

Applied automatically while any stance is up — an effect entered through a feat or ability with the Stance trait (Graham, 20 Oct 2026: any stance): +1 racial on your attack checks, and +1 to your DB against every attack. Fight Defensively and Full Defence are not stances; their actions carry no Stance trait.

stanceConditionals.label: Martial Affinity
stanceConditionals.scope: Attack checks while you are in a stance
